Machine polishing removes an extremely thin layer of clear coat along with the scratches. That layer isn't unlimited, so we start with a paint depth gauge: we measure every panel and check how much clear coat is available. If the paint is already thin on the roof or wings, we use a gentler approach or leave that panel alone.

Next come two or three polishing stages: a cutting compound removes the main defects, and a finishing polish clears up machine holograms. We inspect the result under a detailing lamp that reveals what daylight can hide. Only then do we degrease the surface and apply ceramic coating. We polish with Koch-Chemie compounds and apply Gtechniq ceramic coating.

The real value of paint protection film isn't 'shine', it's preserving the factory paint. A repaint shows up on any paint depth gauge, and that's an immediate knock to the price during a pre-purchase inspection. The film takes the impact instead of the clear coat: fine scratches in the film self-heal in the sun, while deeper ones stay in the film, not the paintwork.

We plot the pattern for your specific model on a cutting plotter, then hand-fit complex areas such as bumpers, mirrors, and pillars. Where the panel shape allows, we wrap the edges underneath. That keeps dirt out of the joins and avoids a thin grey line giving the film away a year later.

We use films from XPEL and SunTek. We'll tell you which one is right for your car during the inspection, before you agree to the quote.

src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.1f5806e05f415ff0: BMW X5, PPF folija i zaštita farova u Beogradu
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.623de60d4f62ec84:
Još jedan BMW X5 zaštićen providnom **PPF folijom**. Folija štiti lak od onoga što bi ga inače oštetilo: kamenčića, peska, tragova insekata i sitnih ogrebotina koje se nakupljaju tokom svakodnevne vožnje. Posebno preporučujemo zaštitu farova. Evo šta ona pruža na prednjem delu:
  • kamenčići i prljavština sa puta ne dopiru do stakla
  • nema ogrebotina ni oštećenja od peska
  • folija zaustavlja UV zrake, pa plastika duže ostaje bez žutila i zamućenja
  • skupa LED i adaptivna svetla duže zadržavaju fabrički izgled
Pozadi je zaštita jednostavnija:
  • nema ogrebotina ni sitnih oštećenja
  • svetla duže ostaju prozirna i sjajna
Farovi su među najosetljivijim delovima automobila. Kamenčići, pesak, prašina, četke u auto-perionici i sunce iz godine u godinu oštećuju površinu svetala. Folija stvara dodatni sloj između njih i plastike i preuzima najveći deo udarca. Možemo zaštititi ceo automobil, samo prednji deo, pojedine delove karoserije ili samo farove.
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.afbece69a5f2ed55: BMW X5, PPF installation and headlight protection in Belgrade
src/content/works/bmw-x5/index.md.e3a66d46f64a9088:
Another BMW X5 protected with clear **PPF film**. The film takes the hits that would otherwise damage the paint: gravel, sand, insect residue, and the minor scratches a car picks up in everyday driving. We also recommend protecting the headlights. Here's what it does for the front:
  • protects the lenses from stones and road debris
  • prevents scratches and sandblasting
  • blocks UV rays, helping the plastic stay clear and resist yellowing for longer
  • keeps expensive LED and adaptive headlights looking factory-fresh
At the rear, the benefits are simple:
  • protects against scratches and minor damage
  • keeps the taillights clear and glossy for longer
Headlights are one of the most vulnerable parts of a car. Year after year, stones, sand, dust, car-wash brushes, and sunlight wear down the lens surface. The film adds a protective layer between the plastic and these hazards, taking most of the impact itself. You can protect the entire car, just the front end, selected body panels, or only the lights.

src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.7b13ab9f07dadce1: Mercedes-Benz GLS, satin paint protection film
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.830a41fa8750d617:
Novi Mercedes-Benz GLS 2026 stigao je kod nas sa dva zadatka: da zaštitimo karoseriju i promenimo njen izgled u satenski. Zajedno sa vlasnikom odabrali smo zaštitnu satensku foliju debljine **190 mikrona** i njome presvlačimo celu karoseriju. Ispod folije fabrička boja ostaje netaknuta: sitne ogrebotine, oštećenja od kamenčića, tragovi insekata, so i prljavština sa puta više ne dopiru do nje. Satenski finiš menja način na koji automobil izgleda na svetlu, dok originalna boja ostaje ispod zaštitnog sloja. Ivice delova podvlačimo tamo gde je to tehnički moguće. Tako se smanjuje broj vidljivih spojeva, završni izgled je ujednačeniji, a folija traje duže. Folija može da se popravlja lokalno. Ako se tokom korišćenja ošteti jedan deo, obično nema potrebe da se ponovo presvlači ceo automobil, folija se menja samo na tom delu. Šta donosi kompletno presvlačenje:
  • fabrička boja ostaje zaštićena od oštećenja od kamenčića i sitnih ogrebotina
  • prljavština sa puta i so ostaju na foliji
  • lakše održavanje karoserije
  • oštećeni deo može da se presvuče zasebno
  • nov automobil je zaštićen od prvih kilometara
  • očuvana fabrička boja koja se vidi prilikom prodaje
  • satenski izgled bez farbanja
PPF foliju postavljamo u Beogradu, na Zvezdari. Možemo da presvučemo i nov automobil i onaj koji je već vožen, celu karoseriju ili samo najizloženije delove. Odgovarajuću foliju izabraćemo prilikom pregleda. Rezultat kompletnog presvlačenja GLS-a satenskom folijom pokazaćemo kada završimo.
src/content/works/mersedes-benz-gls/inde.b5f348e8bd09d007:
The new 2026 Mercedes-Benz GLS came to us with two goals: protect the bodywork and give it a satin finish. Together with the owner, we chose a **190-micron** satin paint protection film and are wrapping the entire vehicle. The factory paintwork remains untouched beneath the film. Small scratches, stone chips, insect residue, road salt and grime can no longer reach it. The satin finish changes how the car looks in the light, while the original colour stays protected underneath. Where technically possible, we wrap the film around the edges of the panels. This leaves fewer visible edges, gives the finish a more seamless look and helps the film last longer. The film can be repaired one panel at a time. If a panel gets damaged during use, there is usually no need to rewrap the entire car. We replace the film only on the affected panel. What a full wrap offers:
  • the factory paintwork stays free of chips and minor scratches
  • road grime and salt stay on the film
  • the bodywork is easier to maintain
  • damaged panels can be rewrapped individually
  • a new car is protected from the very first kilometres
  • preserved paintwork that can be seen when it is time to sell
  • a satin look without repainting
We install PPF in Belgrade, in Zvezdara. We can wrap both new cars and those that have already been on the road, either in full or on the most vulnerable panels. We will help you choose the right film during an inspection. We will share the finished GLS with its full satin wrap once the work is complete.

src/content/works/oklejka-motocziklov-i-.fec44326481da5b0:
We wrap motorcycles, ATVs, and other vehicles in clear film to protect the paint, or colored film to give them a new look.

Clear paint protection film preserves the original paintwork and protects the most vulnerable parts from scratches, minor damage, and dirt.

Colored film does the same while also changing the vehicle's appearance. Choose a new color, an eye-catching finish, or a custom design. And when you're ready for a change, you can have it wrapped again. Even every year.

You can bring your vehicle to us yourself. If that's not convenient, we have **our own transport and trailer**. We'll come and collect your motorcycle or ATV, carry out the work, and arrange a convenient way to return it.

Our client's Toyota Yaris GR Sport in Belgrade. She bought it used, but it was in excellent condition. Rather than wait for the first signs of city life to show, the new owner decided to protect the bodywork straight away.

The Yaris is a compact city car, and city driving is where its bodywork takes the most punishment: tight parking spots outside shops and shopping centres, neighbouring cars, carelessly opened doors, supermarket trolleys, branches and stones kicked up from the road. It's especially frustrating to get a dent or chip just because the person parked next to you opened their door a little too wide.

So we covered the entire body in **190-micron** polyurethane protective film.

PPF adds a tough, transparent layer over the paintwork, taking the hit from minor scratches, scuffs, light parking knocks, road grit and stones. The doors, fenders, bumpers and mirrors need it most, as they're constantly exposed. High-quality clear film is almost invisible, so the car's colour, gloss and appearance stay the same.

PPF won't turn a car into an armoured vehicle, and it can't protect against a serious impact or a deep dent. But it can handle the everyday city damage that leaves paintwork looking tired after a couple of years.

The Yaris left looking just as it did from the factory, only now its bodywork is much better prepared for everyday city driving.

Toyota Yaris GR Sport naše klijentkinje iz Beograda. Automobil je kupljen polovan, ali je u odličnom stanju, pa je nova vlasnica odlučila da ne čeka prve gradske ogrebotine, već da odmah zaštiti karoseriju.

Yaris je kompaktan gradski automobil, a baš u gradu karoserija najviše strada: tesna parking mesta ispred prodavnica i tržnih centara, automobili parkirani pored, neoprezno otvorena vrata, kolica iz supermarketa, grane i kamenčići koji izleću ispod točkova. Najviše zaboli kada se pojavi udubljenje ili oštećenje laka samo zato što je neko na susednom parking mestu otvorio vrata malo šire nego što je trebalo.

Zato smo celu karoseriju oblepili providnom poliuretanskom zaštitnom folijom debljine **190 mikrona**.

PPF na laku stvara čvrst, providan zaštitni sloj koji preuzima na sebe sitne ogrebotine, tragove habanja, posledice lakših kontakata na parkingu, putni pesak i kamenčiće. Najpotrebnija je na vratima, krilima, branicima i retrovizorima, jer su ti delovi stalno izloženi riziku. Kvalitetna providna folija se gotovo ne primećuje, pa boja, sjaj i izgled karoserije ostaju nepromenjeni.

PPF ne pretvara automobil u oklopno vozilo i neće ga zaštititi od jakog udarca ili dubokog udubljenja. Ali štiti od uobičajenih gradskih oštećenja zbog kojih lak posle par godina izgleda istrošeno.

Yaris je otišao u svom fabričkom izdanju, ali je njegova karoserija sada mnogo bolje zaštićena za svakodnevnu vožnju po gradu.
